description: The bar chart illustrates the execution times for two different text-to-SQL generation systems, NatsQL and TA-SQL, across four varying levels of query complexity: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the complexity levels, while the vertical axis indicates the execution time in seconds. For Simple queries, NatsQL has an execution time of approximately 60.21 seconds, and TA-SQL has about 63.14 seconds. In Moderate complexity, NatsQL's execution time is around 39.64 seconds, while TA-SQL's is approximately 48.60 seconds. Challenging queries show NatsQL with an execution time of about 32.32 seconds and TA-SQL with 36.11 seconds. The Total execution time for NatsQL is roughly 51.35 seconds, and for TA-SQL, it is about 56.19 seconds. The bars are color-coded, with NatsQL represented in a lighter shade and TA-SQL in a darker shade. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotations.
